pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular dark brown polygonal regions with sharp edge gradients. The geometry ranges from jagged-edged quadrilaterals on the neck to more expansive, slightly rounded pentagonal structures on the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-tan negative space forming 3-way and 4-way junction nodes. The pathways maintain a relatively thin and consistent pixel-width of approximately 5-8% of patch diameter.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Distinct saw-tooth silhouette along the upper neck profile with high-frequency, low-amplitude vertical pixel spikes corresponding to the mane tufts.

other_distinctive_markers: Small, dark localized silhouette perched on the upper dorsal ridge/mane area, disrupting the geometric continuity of the neck profile.
